features: Fixes remote projector controller JavaScript by replacing browser-dependent implicit element globals with explicit DOM references
Remote feed commands now explicitly post CSRF, event, round, page, auto-page, delay and screen type to live-action.php
Adds robust HTTP/JSON error handling so failed projector commands are shown instead of silently leaving the display on Holding
Adds temporary LIVE STATE diagnostic showing current server screen type, round and state version after every accepted command
Feed buttons now visibly reflect the server-confirmed active state including Holding Screen
Keeps Winner Podium reveal, Results Reveal Safety and single projector-link architecture unchanged
No scoring calculation, results or official BDC points logic changed
No Staging or Production deployment performed
